summary: Contextual container for displaying usage and quota with the existing Meter.
whenToUse: Showing usage of a quota such as members, sends, or storage.
whenNotToUse: Representing an in-progress task: use Progress.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown next to the values.

accessibility: Reuses Meter with role="meter" and a readable value text.
Additional descriptions are linked by the Meter.
customization: Composed with Meter; --dc-* tokens for the container.
commonMistakes: Using the component to represent loading.
limits: The quota must be provided and updated by the caller.
